title: observability-weekly-2026-08-10
content:
Observability weekly notes — week of 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-09

Owners / context:
- Owner: Aisha Patel (observability lead)
- Collabs: Miguel (dashboards), Sofia (tracing), Daniel (cost-telemetry), Priya (on-call)
- Team: eng-observability

High level summary:
- Focus this week: reduce trace sampling variance, refresh serving/runtime dashboards, and push initial alpha of cost-per-model telemetry pipeline.
- Progress: sampling strategy RFC merged to main (see linked PR), dashboard refresh live in staging, cost pipeline MVP ingesting raw billing + inference metrics for last 7 days.
- Incident: brief tail-latency spike on hosted-api us-west1 on 2026-08-05; mitigated by autoscaler bump + cache warm-up. Postmortem in progress.

Standup notes (daily highlights):
- Mon 2026-08-03:
  - Sofia: completed trace-sampling simulator; initial results show 60–65% reduction in sampling variance for tail spans when stratified by model and seq_len.
  - Miguel: prototyped new per-model dashboard layout (latency heatmap + request distribution).
  - Daniel: started integrating cost tags from serving runtime into billing pipeline (model_id, quantization_profile).

- Tue 2026-08-04:
  - Priya: on-call handoff; noticed slight increase in KV cache misses for large-context flows. Opened JIRA-4567.
  - Sofia: adjusted sampling thresholds; need to validate with production traffic sample.
  - Miguel: migrated dashboard queries to materialized views to reduce query cost.

- Wed 2026-08-05 (incident):
  - 10:14 UTC: p99 latency for hosted-api/us-west1 jumped from 220ms -> 540ms for a 20min window.
  - Triage notes: correlated with a scheduled kernel patch on some Dedicated clusters; autoscaling delayed because of increased pod start time. Also saw a transient spike in cold KV cache misses (~3x baseline).
  - Immediate action: bumped replicas for affected pool, enabled temporary routing to secondary region.
  - Postmortem owners: Priya (ops), Sofia (tracing analysis), Miguel (dashboards).

- Thu 2026-08-06:
  - Sofia: tracing trace-tree view added to triage dashboard; helps visualize span dependencies across model-serving components.
  - Daniel: cost pipeline streaming ingest succeeded for one full day; discrepancies with GCP billing tags (~2%); investigating mapping rules.
  - Miguel: started overhaul of alert thresholds for slow database queries surfaced by tracing.

- Fri 2026-08-07:
  - Team retrospective: agreed to increase default trace sampling for low-volume models to improve regression detection.
  - Action item: schedule load test with model-mix representative of tier-2 customers.

Tracing work (Sofia):
- Completed: trace-sampling simulator, trace-tree visualization, improved span naming for router -> runtime -> kernel layers.
- Metrics: sampling variance down ~60% in sim; production shadow sampling (10%) shows improved detection of tail allocations for large-seq requests.
- Next: roll out stratified sampling at 25% for canary customers week of 2026-08-17; instrument memory-alloc spans for deeper analysis.
- Open questions: how to correlate sampling-adjusted error rates with downstream evals (quality regressions).

Dashboards (Miguel):
- Completed: staging dashboards with new layout; added per-model latency heatmap, request-distribution histogram, and span-duration breakdowns.
- Cost-saving: moved heavy queries to materialized views and reduced panel refresh cost by ~40% in staging.
- Todo: finalize UAT with SRE and Customer Success next Tue (2026-08-11). Plan to flip to prod after 48h of stable metrics.

Cost telemetry (Daniel):
- Goal: compute model-level cost per 1M tokens and per-1000 inferences, using runtime metrics + billing export.
- Progress: ingestion + join completed; pipeline emits daily rollups to cost-telemetry.{env}.table. Initial numbers (7-day window):
  - top 5 models account for ~71% of inference spend
  - quantized model variants show ~2.2x improvement in token throughput per GPU-hour vs fp16 baseline
- Issues: billing tags inconsistent for some marketplace instances; working with infra to standardize labels.
- Next: add anomaly detection on daily spend deltas and alerting to CostOps channel.

Incidents & Alerts:
- 2026-08-05 p99 spike (see above). Postmortem timeline drafted; expected publish date 2026-08-13.
- Alert tuning: lowered sensitivity on some noisy DB-query alerts; added a composite alert combining p95 latency + increased cold KV miss rate to reduce false positives.

Roadmap & priorities (next 2 weeks):
1) Tracing: canary stratified sampling rollout + instrument memory alloc spans (Sofia)
2) Dashboards: prod flip + CS / SRE UAT (Miguel)
3) Cost telemetry: anomaly detection + mapping cleanup (Daniel)
4) Observability test harness: run model-mix load test and validate alerting (Priya + release-eng)

Action items (owner, due):
- Sofia: roll out stratified sampling to 25% canary customers (due 2026-08-17).
- Miguel: complete UAT and flip dashboard to prod (due 2026-08-13).
- Daniel: finish billing tag mapping rules and reduce mismatch to <0.5% (due 2026-08-14).
- Priya: run model-mix load test and capture end-to-end traces (due 2026-08-18).
- Aisha: draft incident postmortem and circulate to SRE/eng leadership (draft due 2026-08-12).

Blockers:
- Billing tag inconsistencies require infra changes; blocked on infra-labels RFC review (waiting on infra-eng).
- Dedicated cluster kernel patch scheduling coordination (SRE owning) — need clearer maintenance windows to avoid customer-impacting autoscaler delays.

Notes / misc:
- Proposed RFC: standardize model_id and quant_profile tags in runtime emitted metrics and billing export (link in linked_artifacts). Please review before next sync.
- Quick wins: change default dashboard refresh interval for large teams from 15s -> 30s to reduce query costs; Miguel to implement.

Meetings scheduled next week:
- Observability sync (Mon 2026-08-10 10:00 PT) — focus on canary rollout plan.
- Cross-team postmortem review (Thu 2026-08-13 09:00 PT).
- CostOps weekly (Fri 2026-08-14 11:00 PT).

Appendix: quick metrics snapshot (7-day rolling window to 2026-08-09)
- p50 / p95 / p99 (hosted-api global): 28ms / 120ms / 320ms (baseline prior week p99=310ms)
- Trace coverage (all services): 86% spans annotated with model_id (goal 95%)
- KV cache miss rate (large-context flows): 4.8% (baseline 1.6%) — investigating correlation with recent runtime change
- Daily cost ingestion lag: ~6h median; worst-case 14h

If anything is missing or if you want the raw query list for dashboards / materialized views, ping Miguel or check the linked PR.

---
Notes to self: keep this doc lightweight; prefer link-first approach for long tables / queries (Confluence + GitHub).
